requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Case number of the existing criminal case, from the deferral order
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Case number of the existing criminal case, from the deferral order
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no case identifier is held for this record
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the existing criminal case number, copied from the deferral order - the motion is filed in the existing case, not as a new one

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Date the court entered the order deferring imposition of sentence
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date the court entered the order deferring imposition of sentence
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no order fact is held for this record, and the order's date decides which unit of the packet applies
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the date of the deferral order, checked against the order itself - its date decides which version of Rule 32.1 applies, and a pre-2019 felony deferral is a reason to stop and get advice

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Level of the offence - felony, misdemeanor or infraction - as the deferral order states it
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Level of the offence - felony, misdemeanor or infraction - as the deferral order states it
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no offence fact is held for this record
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the offence level, copied from the deferral order; it decides whether the felony-reduction application can apply

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Date the defendant's probation expired or terminated, from the discharge record
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date the defendant's probation expired or terminated, from the discharge record
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no supervision fact is held for this record
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the date probation expired or terminated, checked against the probation discharge record - it fixes the date the sixty-one days run from

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: County of the sentencing court, named in the caption of the motion
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: County of the sentencing court, named in the caption of the motion
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the sentencing court is a case fact the participant establishes from the deferral order
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: which North Dakota county's district court deferred imposition - it is on the deferral order, and the clerk of court of the sentencing court can confirm it

protectedBlanks.label: [  ] The defendant applies for reduction of the felony to a misdemeanor before dismissal (mark only where the offence was a felony and you ask for it)
protectedBlanks.why: the reduction is available on the defendant's own application under N.D.C.C. Sec. 12.1-32-07.1; whether to apply is the participant's own choice and the route does not determine it

protectedBlanks.label: Signature of the defendant on the motion
protectedBlanks.why: the defendant signs the motion personally; nothing is signed on the verification unit

protectedBlanks.label: Date beside the defendant's signature on the motion
protectedBlanks.why: a date written before the motion is signed would be false
